verses.label: Verse 3
lines: It followed her to school one day,
School one day, school one day,
It followed her to school one day,

See the pin at 35.19 s.

"Its fleece was white as snow": the other verses sing this line D#4 D#4 F4 D#4 C#4 after a pickup (67.67 s, 77.68 s). Here D#4 17.99, D#4 18.23, F4 18.45, D4 18.62, C#4 18.94; the matcher had started on the breathy pickup at 17.30 s and put every word one note early.
See the pin at 17.99 s.
"Ma-": D#4 for 0.21 s rising straight into F4, the lead-in every line of this tune has here (0.14-0.20 s in the other lines); just over the automatic 0.20 s limit.

"a lit-tle lamb" ends F4, F4 here (11.76 and 12.02 s), as the same line does in the other verses (小绵羊 ends F4 F4 F4). "a lit-" run together on the held D#4 before it. The matcher had pushed "lamb" onto the first note of the next line.
